name: llm-mock
description: A configurable mock LLM API server for testing and development
author: Piyook <contact@piyook.com>

scripts.postinstall: test -d ui && npm --prefix ui install || true
scripts.test:chatgpt: npm run llm-mock:start:chatgpt && node -e "setTimeout(() => process.exit(0), 3000)" && cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/gpt-mock-spec.cy.ts && npm run llm-mock:stop
scripts.test:gemini: npm run llm-mock:start:gemini && node -e "setTimeout(() => process.exit(0), 3000)" && cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/gemini-mock-spec.cy.ts && npm run llm-mock:stop
scripts.test:streaming: npm run llm-mock:start:streaming && node -e "setTimeout(() => process.exit(0), 3000)" && cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/streaming-only-spec.cy.ts && npm run llm-mock:stop
scripts.test:embeddings: npm run llm-mock:start:embeddings && node -e "setTimeout(() => process.exit(0), 3000)" && cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/embeddings-spec.cy.ts && npm run llm-mock:stop
scripts.test:e2e: npm run compile-ui && npm run test:chatgpt && npm run test:gemini && npm run test:streaming && npm run test:embeddings
scripts.llm-mock:start:chatgpt: npm run compile-ui && node bin/llm-mock.js start --model=chatgpt
scripts.llm-mock:start:gemini: npm run compile-ui && node bin/llm-mock.js start --model=gemini
scripts.llm-mock:start:streaming: npm run compile-ui && node bin/llm-mock.js start --model=streaming
scripts.llm-mock:start:embeddings: npm run compile-ui && node bin/llm-mock.js start --model=embeddings
